map.CSAT ≥90 为优秀、≥75 为良好、≥50 为合格、低于 50 为需改善。: CSAT >=90 is excellent, >=75 is good, >=50 is acceptable, and below 50 needs improvement. In the example above, 80% lands in the "good" band; if detractors exceed 20% an extra warning about negative word of mouth appears.
map.CSAT 和 NPS 有什么区别？: What is the difference between CSAT and NPS?
map.CSAT 衡量「满意」（4-5 星占比），关注整体体验；NPS 衡量「忠诚」（推: CSAT measures "satisfaction" (the share of 4-5 star ratings) and focuses on the overall experience; NPS measures "loyalty" (promoters% - detractors%) and focuses on repurchase and word of mouth. This tool shows both side by side: in the example CSAT=80%, NPS=42.
map.CSAT客户满意度评分 使用指南: CSAT Customer Satisfaction Score User Guide
map.→ 打开CSAT客户满意度评分工具: -> Open the CSAT customer satisfaction score tool
map.录入各星级评价人数，自动计算 CSAT 得分、满意度分布与 NPS 趋势参考，评: Enter the number of ratings at each star level to compute the CSAT score, the satisfaction distribution and an NPS trend reference, and assess the customer experience.
map.服务评级：按 CSAT 阈值（≥90 优秀 / ≥75 良好 / ≥50 合格: Service rating: assign a level by the CSAT thresholds (>=90 excellent / >=75 good / >=50 acceptable / otherwise needs improvement) and judge from the detractor share whether remediation is triggered.
map.满意度核算：录入各星级评价人数（1-5 星），工具算出 CSAT（4-5 星占比: Satisfaction accounting: enter the number of ratings at each star level (1-5) and the tool computes the CSAT (the share of 4-5 stars), the NPS (promoters - detractors), the average star rating and a rating.
map.等级评定依据什么阈值？: What thresholds are the ratings based on?
map.趋势对比：将不同周期（本月 vs 上月）的星级分布分别核算，量化服务改善幅度，支: Trend comparison: account for the star distribution of different periods (this month vs last month) separately to quantify the improvement and support KPI reviews and team incentives.
